name: @hasna/test-guard
description: Machine-wide bun test concurrency and memory guard (SC-00062): the flock-semaphore wrapper, the sentinel that watches it, and the regression battery — packaged so the control ships through the normal PR -> review -> publish -> install chain

scripts.scan:artifact: bun pm pack --ignore-scripts --quiet --filename "$PWD/test-guard-artifact-scan.tgz" && bunx @hasna/contracts@0.11.1 artifact-scan test-guard-artifact-scan.tgz; rc=$?; rm -f "$PWD/test-guard-artifact-scan.tgz"; exit $rc
